item.title: The Ethereum Perspective on Post-Quantum Cryptography
item.description: For slides, please see the ‘Extra Info’ tab Ethereum’s Three Layers — All Depend on Elliptic Curves Layer Current cryptography Execution secp256k1 Consensus BLS12-381 Data availability sampling BLS12-381 (The DA layer is more explicit in Ethereum than in Bitcoin. Each layer has many client implementations, all sharing the underlying EC assumptions.) The Roadmap (with a governance caveat) Caveat: this “strawman” reflects the Ethereum Foundation’s vision, not a guarantee — Ethereum governance is complicated, and this is an attempt to guide the community.
